an3.7:1.1: “Bhikkhus, one who possesses three qualities should be known as a fool.
an3.7:1.3: Blameworthy bodily action, blameworthy verbal action, and blameworthy mental action. One who possesses these three qualities should be known as a fool. “One who possesses three qualities should be known as a wise person. What three? Blameless bodily action, blameless verbal action, and blameless mental action. One who possesses these three qualities should be known as a wise person. “Therefore … It is in this way that you should train yourselves.”
